reviewNote: AI-authored implementation draft. A qualified Spanish educator must approve each node before pilot use.

nodes.title: Open warmly
nodes.objective: Greet someone and introduce yourself
nodes.prompt: Say hello and introduce yourself in Spanish.
nodes.rubric: Includes an appropriate greeting and self-introduction
nodes.transferPrompt: Greet a neighbor at a different time of day

nodes.title: Ask for repetition
nodes.objective: Ask someone to repeat more slowly
nodes.prompt: You did not hear the last sentence. Ask for repetition.
nodes.rubric: Makes a clear, polite repair request
nodes.transferPrompt: Ask a friend to repeat one word

nodes.title: Clarify meaning
nodes.objective: Ask what an unfamiliar word means
nodes.prompt: Ask what a word means.
nodes.commonError: Repeating the unknown word without a question
nodes.rubric: Identifies the unknown item and requests meaning
nodes.transferPrompt: Clarify an unfamiliar phrase in a shop

nodes.title: Confirm what you heard
nodes.objective: Check that you understood correctly
nodes.prompt: Confirm the time you heard.
nodes.rubric: Restates the key fact and requests confirmation

nodes.title: Repair in a new situation
nodes.objective: Combine greeting, clarification, and confirmation
nodes.prompt: Begin a conversation, repair one misunderstanding, and confirm the answer.
nodes.rubric: Uses at least two repair strategies appropriately
nodes.transferPrompt: Repeat with a different person and fact

nodes.title: Order politely
nodes.objective: Order one item politely
nodes.prompt: Order a coffee politely.
nodes.rubric: Makes an understandable polite order

nodes.title: Ask the price
nodes.objective: Ask how much something costs
nodes.prompt: Ask the price of an item.
nodes.rubric: Requests the price unambiguously

nodes.title: State a preference
nodes.objective: Say what you prefer and give a simple reason
nodes.prompt: State which option you prefer.
nodes.commonError: Naming an option without preference language
nodes.rubric: States a preference with a comprehensible reason

nodes.title: Explain a constraint
nodes.objective: Communicate a dietary or practical constraint
nodes.prompt: Explain one thing you cannot have.
nodes.commonError: Using no me gusta for a safety constraint
nodes.rubric: Clearly communicates the constraint

nodes.title: Complete a purchase
nodes.objective: Order, clarify, and confirm a purchase
nodes.prompt: Complete a short purchase conversation.
nodes.commonError: Failing to confirm the final choice
nodes.rubric: Completes request, clarification, and confirmation
nodes.transferPrompt: Buy a ticket instead of food

nodes.title: Ask where
nodes.objective: Ask where a place is
nodes.prompt: Ask where the station is.
nodes.rubric: Asks clearly for a destination

nodes.title: Follow directions
nodes.objective: Confirm a short sequence of directions
nodes.prompt: Restate two direction steps.
nodes.rubric: Restates the route in the correct order
nodes.transferPrompt: Confirm a route with a left turn

nodes.title: Ask when
nodes.objective: Ask departure or opening time
nodes.prompt: Ask what time the bus leaves.
nodes.rubric: Requests the relevant time

nodes.title: Choose transport
nodes.objective: Compare two simple transport options
nodes.prompt: Choose between bus and train and say why.
nodes.rubric: Chooses and gives a relevant comparison

nodes.title: Recover while traveling
nodes.objective: Ask, clarify, and confirm travel information
nodes.prompt: Find a route after missing one detail.
nodes.rubric: Obtains and confirms usable route information

nodes.title: Ask about interests
nodes.objective: Ask what someone likes doing
nodes.prompt: Ask about a person's interests.
nodes.commonError: Turning it into a yes/no question
nodes.rubric: Asks an open, understandable interest question

nodes.title: Share an interest
nodes.objective: Share an interest and one detail
nodes.prompt: Share an activity you enjoy.
nodes.rubric: Shares an interest with a supporting detail

nodes.title: Suggest a plan
nodes.objective: Suggest doing something together
nodes.prompt: Suggest a simple plan.
nodes.rubric: Makes a clear, socially appropriate suggestion

nodes.title: Set a follow-up
nodes.objective: Agree on when and how to follow up
nodes.prompt: Agree on a follow-up time.
nodes.rubric: Makes a specific follow-up agreement
nodes.transferPrompt: Move the plan to another day

nodes.title: From small talk to plan
nodes.objective: Discover an interest and make a fitting plan
nodes.prompt: Have a short exchange that ends with a plan.
nodes.commonError: Suggesting before learning the other preference
nodes.rubric: Connects the stated interest to a confirmed plan

nodes.title: Tell what happened
nodes.objective: Describe three events in sequence
nodes.prompt: Describe a short experience in order.
nodes.rubric: Communicates a coherent three-step sequence

nodes.title: React and ask more
nodes.objective: React to a story and ask a follow-up
nodes.prompt: React to good news and ask one follow-up.
nodes.rubric: Shows an appropriate reaction and asks a related question

nodes.title: Explain a misunderstanding
nodes.objective: State what you meant and contrast it with what was heard
nodes.prompt: Correct a misunderstanding politely.
nodes.rubric: Rephrases the intended meaning politely

nodes.title: Resolve a practical problem
nodes.objective: Explain a problem and request a remedy
nodes.prompt: Explain that you received the wrong item and request help.
nodes.rubric: Explains the mismatch and makes a reasonable request

nodes.title: Handle an unexpected turn
nodes.objective: Narrate, clarify, and resolve in one exchange
nodes.prompt: Describe what happened, repair one misunderstanding, and agree on a next step.
nodes.commonError: Accepting a next step without confirming it
nodes.rubric: Maintains a coherent account and reaches a confirmed resolution
